observations: body L1: «tor» ends the letter-spaced name Cantor, begun on p. 184 («Can-»).
body L15: the head of the notes on chapter 12, «Ad» and «caput» in small capitals, in the larger type of the heads.
body L17: a heavy opening bracket stands before «« Sol tardus»; no closing bracket follows on the page; kept as printed.
body L20: checked: near the equinoxes the declination of the Sun changes by about 23′ a day (sin ε × 59′ of longitude), about 12′ between rising and setting, so «amplius 11 minutis» holds.

body L21-L31: the figure stands at the left of lines 21 to 31, which are set beside it in a narrow measure. It is redrawn from measurements of the print: the horizon, printed a little wider than high (61.2 by 59.8 pt), as an ellipse; the meridian MN as a straight line through Z, with the dot P on it; the two parallels of the Sun S′σ and σ′S as arcs of circles with a common centre; the lines M′N′, S′ZV and SZV′ in dashes, each dash where it printed; the bold italic letters, the primes and the Greek σ.
body L23: a small mark stands under the e of «veraciter»; it is not a sign.
body L36: «ob ortu» is printed for ab ortu; kept as printed.
notes_left L1-L2: the name is divided as «al-» (a hyphen, 3.5 pt) and «–Battānī» (a long dash, 4.4 pt), as printed; the hyphen of «ni-» at the end of L2 did not print.
notes_left L4: the hyphen of «pro-» printed only as a dot.
notes_right L2: the hyphen of «Regiomon-» is printed short (1.9 pt); «das» stands for dass, kept as printed.
notes_right L4: «nich» is printed for nicht; kept as printed.
notes_left, notes_right: the signature 24 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
